label: Minimum flight speed rises with altitude (ISA troposphere)
statement_en: In the ISA troposphere air density falls with height, and the minimum flight speed sqrt(2W/(rho S C_Lmax)) rises with height (v_min proportional to 1/sqrt(rho)).

hypotheses.name: see theorem statement
hypotheses.statement: the named hypothesis structure(s) in the theorem statement; instantiated with fetched numbers in Delphi.Perturb.measured

scope.basis: standard atmosphere (Narayanan and Osechas 2022); troposphere only (h < T0/beta)

sources: Narayanan S, Osechas O 2022, Enhanced Vertical Navigation Using Barometric Measurements. (PMID 36501962, doi:10.3390/s22239263); lean/perturb-sources.json#narayanan2022

lean.source:
/-- **In the ISA troposphere the minimum speed rises with height.** -/
theorem vmin_isa_mono (A : ISATroposphere) {Cmax W S h₁ h₂ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hC : 0 < Cmax) (hW : 0 ≤ W)
    (h : h₁ ≤ h₂) (htop : h₂ < A.T0 / A.beta) :
    vmin (A.rho h₁) Cmax W S ≤ vmin (A.rho h₂) Cmax W S := by
  unfold vmin
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  have hr₂ := isa_rho_pos A htop
  have hle := isa_rho_anti A h htop
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle hS.le) hC.le

named_hypotheses.name: Delphi.Perturb.ISATroposphere
named_hypotheses.source:
/-- The troposphere of the barometric formula: `rho(h) = rho0 (1 - beta h / T0)^n`, `n > 0` (for the ISA
`n = g0 / (R_d beta) - 1`, about 4.256). -/
structure ISATroposphere where
  rho0 : ℝ
  T0 : ℝ
  beta : ℝ
  n : ℝ
  rho0_pos : 0 < rho0
  T0_pos : 0 < T0
  beta_pos : 0 < beta
  n_pos : 0 < n

constraint_details.canEliminate: a design flying at altitude at a speed that is only enough at sea level
